_lisezmoi: Règle de validité du passeport par pays, lue dans la fiche « Entry, Exit and Visa Requirements » de l'API Consular Affairs (cadataapi.state.gov), relue à la main le 2026-10-15. quote = phrase officielle mot pour mot ; sha256 de la fiche dans src/data/official.json : si la fiche change, la GitHub Action ouvre une issue et la règle se relit. kind : entry (valide à l'entrée, aucun minimum écrit), stay (valide toute la durée du séjour), afterDeparture (N mois après la date de départ), afterEntry (N mois après la date d'arrivée). recommend : conseil du Département d'État en plus de la règle. Exception : pour les Philippines (RP) et l'Inde (IN), la fiche de l'API ne porte aucune règle de validité ; la règle vient de l'encadré de la page pays officielle de travel.state.gov, lue dans sa dernière copie archivée par web.archive.org (source = archive ; date de la copie dans official.json, relue le 2026-10-16) ; kind afterVisa : N mois après la demande de visa.

quote: Air travel: You need a passport book to enter Mexico. You can’t use a U.S. passport card to board a plane at the airport.
Land travel: You need a passport book or card to enter Mexico.

extra.en: Mexico also requires an FMM entry permit, online or from an INM office, even within 12 miles of the border.
extra.es: México exige además el permiso de entrada FMM, en línea o en una oficina del INM, incluso a menos de 20 kilómetros de la frontera.

quote: U.S. citizens can use a valid U.S. passport, passport card, or NEXUS card to enter
If you are flying into the U.S. from Canada, you must show a U.S. passport book or another approved ID.

extra.en: Coming home by air from Canada takes a passport book or another approved document: the card only works at land and sea crossings.
extra.es: Para volver en avión desde Canadá hace falta la libreta u otro documento aprobado: la tarjeta solo sirve en cruces por tierra y por mar.

quote: Disembarked cruise ship passengers without a passport valid for 6 months must pay a daily migration escort service fee of approximately $125 USD.

extra.en: Every traveler completes an eTicket for each entry and exit, and the $10 tourist card is included in airline charges.
extra.es: Cada viajero llena un eTicket en cada entrada y salida, y la tarjeta de turista de 10 dólares va incluida en el boleto aéreo.

quote: U.S. citizens are generally required to present a valid U.S. passport when traveling to Jamaica, as well as proof of anticipated departure from Jamaica.
If you are traveling to Jamaica on a cruise, you may use another Western Hemisphere Travel Initiative (WHTI) compliant document.

extra.en: Tourist stays up to 90 days need no visa.
extra.es: Las estancias turísticas de hasta 90 días no requieren visa.

quote: U.S. citizens are generally required to present a valid U.S. passport when traveling to The Bahamas, as well as proof of anticipated departure from The Bahamas.
Those traveling to The Bahamas on a cruise may use another Western Hemisphere Travel Initiative (WHTI) compliant document, such as a U.S. passport card.

extra.en: Tourists need no visa for stays up to 90 days.
extra.es: Los turistas no necesitan visa para estancias de hasta 90 días.

quote: A valid passport for the duration of your stay.
Immigration may deny your entry if the passport is damaged.

extra.en: Authorities may allow up to 180 days without a visa, but this is not guaranteed.
extra.es: Las autoridades pueden permitir hasta 180 días sin visa, pero no está garantizado.

quote: You must show a valid U.S. passport to enter and leave Colombia if you are not a Colombian citizen.

extra.en: Fill in the free Check-Mig form 72 hours before the flight; dual U.S.-Colombian citizens enter and leave on the Colombian passport.
extra.es: Llene el formulario gratuito Check-Mig 72 horas antes del vuelo; quien tiene doble nacionalidad entra y sale con el pasaporte colombiano.

quote: Peru requires everyone entering the country to have passports valid for at least six months from the date of entry into Peru.
Travelers with less than six months validity in their passports will be refused entry into Peru.

extra.en: Keep the entry record: without it you cannot leave until immigration confirms when you arrived.
extra.es: Guarde el registro de entrada: sin él no puede salir hasta que Migraciones confirme cuándo llegó.

quote: You need a U.S. passport and either a Salvadoran visa or a one-entry tourist card to enter El Salvador.
The card is valid for 90 days or 180 days depending on passport validity and/or purpose of travel

extra.en: The tourist card costs $12 at the airport or seaport; the CA-4 agreement lets you move among El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua for 90 days in total.
extra.es: La tarjeta de turista cuesta 12 dólares en el aeropuerto o el puerto; el acuerdo CA-4 permite moverse entre El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras y Nicaragua 90 días en total.

quote: To enter Guatemala, you need a U.S. passport that is valid when you arrive with at least one blank page for an entry and exit stamp.
There is no required minimum validity period for a U.S. passport, and U.S. citizens do not need a visa.

extra.en: An electronic immigration form is filled in to enter and to leave; stays are usually 90 days.
extra.es: Para entrar y salir se llena un formulario electrónico de migración; la estancia suele ser de 90 días.

quote: To enter Honduras, you need: A U.S. passport with at least six months validity. Evidence of onward travel.

extra.en: No visa for tourist stays up to 90 days.
extra.es: No se necesita visa para estancias turísticas de hasta 90 días.

quote: Your passport must be valid for the entire length of your stay in the United Kingdom.
Many countries require the passport to be valid for 6 months or more during travel.

extra.en: An Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) is needed before travel for tourism, family visits or business of 6 months or less.
extra.es: Hace falta una autorización electrónica de viaje (ETA) antes de viajar por turismo, familia o negocios hasta 6 meses.

quote: You must have a valid passport to enter Ireland.
There is no minimum passport validity requirement for U.S. citizens entering Ireland.
We recommend you have a passport that is valid for the duration of your stay, evidence of sufficient funds to support your stay in Ireland, and a return airline ticket.

extra.en: Ireland is not in the Schengen area: the three-month rule only applies if you continue to a Schengen country.
extra.es: Irlanda no está en el espacio Schengen: la regla de los tres meses solo se aplica si sigue hacia un país Schengen.

quote: Your passport should be valid for at least three months beyond the period of stay if you plan on transiting a Schengen country.
We recommend that your passport have at least six months’ validity remaining.

extra.en: France does not accept the 12-page emergency passport issued abroad for visa-free entry.
extra.es: Francia no acepta el pasaporte de emergencia de 12 páginas emitido en el extranjero para entrar sin visa.

quote: Your passport must be valid for at least 3 months beyond the period of stay.
If your passport has ever been reported as lost or stolen, or is expired, Italian authorities could deny you entry and return you immediately to the United States.

extra.en: Tourist and business stays up to 90 days need no visa.
extra.es: Las estancias de turismo y negocios de hasta 90 días no necesitan visa.

quote: Your passport should be valid for at least 3 months beyond your period of stay if you plan on transiting a Schengen country.
We recommend you have at least 6 month’s validity remaining.

extra.en: The Schengen 90-day limit counts every Schengen country together, Spain included.
extra.es: El límite Schengen de 90 días suma todos los países Schengen, España incluida.

quote: Your passport should be valid for at least 3 months beyond your period of stay if you plan on transiting a Schengen country.
We recommend you have at least 6 month’s validity remaining.

extra.en: Germany is in the Schengen area: the three months count from the day you leave the last Schengen country, not Germany.
extra.es: Alemania está en el espacio Schengen: los tres meses cuentan desde el día en que sale del último país Schengen, no de Alemania.

quote: For entry into Greece, your passport should have at least six months of remaining validity.

While Greek law requires three months of passport validity beyond the intended date of your departure, if you are transiting a country that requires six months of validity, you may not be permitted to continue your trip.

extra.en: The State Department recommends six months to avoid disruptions on connections.
extra.es: El Departamento de Estado recomienda seis meses para evitar problemas en las conexiones.

quote: Your passport must be valid for the entire time you are staying in Japan.
Airlines in Japan may not let you board if you don't have the right travel documents for your next destination, or if your passport has less than 6 months of validity.

extra.en: Visa-free stays are up to 90 days with proof of a return or onward ticket.
extra.es: Las estancias sin visa son de hasta 90 días con boleto de regreso o de continuación.

quote: We strongly recommend that your passport be valid for at least six months beyond the date of your arrival in Thailand to avoid possible denied entry.

extra.en: Tourists staying fewer than 60 days need no visa but must register online before arrival.
extra.es: Los turistas que se quedan menos de 60 días no necesitan visa, pero deben registrarse en línea antes de llegar.

quote: Passports must be valid for six months beyond your entry date.
You will be denied entry into Turkey if there is not enough space for entry and exit stamps in your passport.

extra.en: Ordinary passport holders are exempt from a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
extra.es: Con pasaporte ordinario no se necesita visa hasta 90 días en cualquier periodo de 180 días.

quote: Passport Validity: A passport valid for at least six months beyond the date of entry is required to enter the UAE.

extra.en: The rule applies at every UAE port of entry, Dubai and Abu Dhabi included.
extra.es: La regla vale en todos los puntos de entrada de los Emiratos, Dubái y Abu Dabi incluidos.

quote: You must obtain a visa prior to arriving in the People’s Republic of China (PRC). Your passport must have at least six months' validity remaining.
Transiting without a visa requires a valid passport with at least six months of remaining validity, a visa for your onward destination (if required), and an onward ticket from the same city.

extra.en: If your visa sits in an old passport, the details on the valid passport and the visa must match exactly.
extra.es: Si la visa está en un pasaporte viejo, los datos del pasaporte vigente y de la visa deben coincidir exactamente.

quote: You must have a valid passport and a visa (or pre-approval for a visa on arrival) to enter Vietnam.
Your passport must be valid for six months beyond your planned stay, and you must have at least one blank visa page (not including the endorsement page).

extra.en: E-visas are issued for the period requested: a delayed departure means overstay fines.
extra.es: La visa electrónica se emite para el periodo pedido: salir tarde significa multas por exceso de estancia.

quote: PASSPORT VALIDITY: 6 months beyond the end of your planned stay.
BLANK PASSPORT PAGES: Sufficient space for an entry visa stamp.

extra.en: Staying past the “admit until” date stamped in your passport can mean fines or detention by the Bureau of Immigration.
extra.es: Quedarse después de la fecha «admit until» sellada en el pasaporte puede acarrear multas o detención por la Oficina de Inmigración.

quote: Must be valid for 6 months past the date of visa application to obtain a visa.
2 blank passport pages required.

extra.en: A valid Indian visa or OCI card is required to enter and exit; the eVisa for stays under 60 days is requested at least 4 days before arrival.
extra.es: Hace falta una visa india vigente o una tarjeta OCI para entrar y salir; la visa electrónica para estancias de menos de 60 días se pide al menos 4 días antes de llegar.
